description: An oil-painting style scene of a cluttered desk in a dim room under a lamp. A beige all-in-one computer with a small screen shows a page layout with text columns and image boxes. Beside it, a beige laser-style printer is feeding out a newspaper-style page with photos. Floppy disks, a coffee mug, a keyboard, a mouse and a ruler sit on the wood desk. Grey cubicle partitions fill the background, and a sheet of paper on the left wall has illegible marks.
